description: This file implements a singly linked list data structure with functionalities to add, remove, get elements, and compute the size. It defines a LinkedList class, an internal Node class, and includes helper functions such as finding the tail node.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list class with methods to manipulate list elements.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Node class representing individual elements in the linked list, encapsulating data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list, returning true if successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes a node from the list by updating references.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Helper function to find the last node in the list.
